prompt:
WEAPON: Spear of Gwanchang (관창의 창), the spear of Korea myth, wielded in legend by 관창. Legend: 화랑 관창이 황산벌에서 두 번 말을 달려 백제 진영에 뛰어든 창. 그의 죽음이 신라군의 기세를 일으켰다.

WEAPON LOOK (materials and colors; shape; motifs): slender cavalry spear with a red horsehair tassel and a gilt hwarang crest, cinnabar red, gilt bronze and pine green; long and charging; a horse mane, flower-knight ribbons and pine needles.

STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and weapon detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.

OUTPUT: the CURSED state of the attached action image — not her power opened, but the weapon’s own legend turned against her: its price, its obsession, its tragedy. Keep the attached image’s camera, pose, framing, subject scale, face, hair and the base armor exactly; the silver plates stay silver. Change only this: her rune and glow lines are corrupted from their clean color to a sick red-violet that flickers, the engravings crack and bleed light along the seams, any feathers, cloth or halo elements split, fray or break, her eyes take the same corrupted light and her expression hardens or empties. The pair must read as the same picture before and after the curse takes hold.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature, no text, no lettering on banners or walls, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

HANDS: as in the attached image — ordinary human hands holding nothing. The weapon stays in her armor and design, never a separate object in her hands, beside her or floating near her.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.
